You can pick one and we'll send a calendar invite and an ICS to all participants.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 2025-04-15, 2:00–2:15 PM PT
- Wed 2025-04-16, 2:00–2:15 PM PT
- Thu 2025-04-17, 3:30–3:45 PM PT

If you prefer a 30-minute deep-dive, we can extend the Wed slot to 2:00–2:30 PM.

Please confirm which window works and list attendees (names + emails). I'll handle the invite and loop in procurement for any pre-demo paperwork.

I've attached a quick PDF that explains the timebank flow and a short mutual action plan template so procurement can see the typical contract milestones.

Attachments: timebank-instructions.pdf, RWI_Acme_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Q2.xlsx
